notes: Item 19 discloses two sections: (A) average annual gross sales for stores open at least 24 months (2023 and 2024 calendar years, broken out by combined/franchisee-owned/affiliate-owned), and (B) average first year gross sales for new stores opened January 1, 2022 through December 31, 2023 (broken out by new single-unit franchisee, new multi-unit franchisee, and affiliate-owned). Gross Sales excludes sales tax and online sales through FFS Digital LLC revenue sharing program. No cost, profit, or margin data is disclosed. Affiliate-owned stores (FFSDC) are treated as company-owned for Item 19 purposes.
